headerDisplay: Homebridge plugin for HomGar, Diivoo, and RainPoint smart garden irrigation systems.
footerDisplay: Create a dedicated account in the HomGar/Diivoo app and share your home with it. Using your main account will cause the app to log out when the plugin authenticates.

email.title: Email
email.description: Your HomGar/Diivoo account email (use a dedicated account, not your main one)

areaCode.title: Country Code
areaCode.description: Phone country code for your account (44 for UK, 1 for US)

pollInterval.title: Poll Interval (seconds)
pollInterval.description: How often to check device status (minimum 60 seconds)

defaultWateringDuration.title: Default Watering Duration (seconds)
defaultWateringDuration.description: Default duration when starting watering from HomeKit (10 minutes default)
